items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He had Lenny Lynn with him, and Tommy playing trumpet.

ctx.x: Yeah, you know. He had the group called the Enforcers. Clarence? Steven knows him. I just can’t think of Clarence’s last name. He was a very good saxophone player. He had this group called the Enforcers. He had Lenny Lynn with him, and Tommy playing trumpet.
I can’t think who you’re talking about. I think I know who you’re talking about.
